d: 15 navanbar ko jharkhand 27van sthapna divas manane ja raha hai. rajy gathan ke 27 sal pure hone par jahan sarkar apni uplabdhiyan ginane men juti hai, vahi vibhinn samajik sangthan bhi sthapna divas ko lekar utsah jahir kar rahe hain, lekin in jashn aur uplabdhiyon ke bich samaj ka ek aisa varg bhi hai, jo jharkhand ke vikas ki vastavik tasvir par saval khare kar raha hai, yah varg hai rajy ke bujurgon ka.
